title: Nominated Leak memory
description: What a Leak account exports when it puts 3 to 10 of the theorems its runs saved for one target forward for Tengoku. Every field here is re-derived or re-checked by the intake; none is trusted.

statement.description: the target's Lean statement, for context only; the target itself is not an entry unless it was proved

author.description: the account that ran and nominated; the attribution on every record

id.description: hash of the statement with its name removed

closure.description: the theorem with every helper declaration it needs, compile-ready
